posts.author: office-coordinator
posts.body:
Gate 3 is stuck again. Maintenance says it is the weather. It has been raining since November.

Until it is fixed, please use gate 2.

posts.author: team-lead
posts.body: A truck with a trailer does not fit through gate 2.

author: team-lead
title: Route sheets, please fill them in

posts.author: team-lead
posts.body:
Three route sheets this week only said "misc". Drivers then do not know what to unload.

Please write down the recipient and the count. Even when it is urgent.

posts.author: dispatch-coordinator-2
posts.body: When it is urgent, the urgency is exactly the problem.
